subject: general
question: Which woman scientist received the Padma Shri, 2022, in the field of Science and Engineering?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Dr Sanghamitra Bandyopadhyay. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanghamitra Bandyopadhyay **received the Padma Shri, 2022, for her scholarly record in algorithmic optimization and for its significant impact on birth data analysis.
 
• Her discoveries include an **inborn marker for heart cancer,** a determination of the occurrence of HIV and cancers and the work of white matter in **Alzheimer's Disease**. 
 
• Sanghamitra Bandyopadhyay is presently the director of the Indian Statistical Institute( ISI)**, Kolkata.**
 
• She took the Infosys** Prize in Engineering and Computer Science in 2017** and was the other woman scientist to take the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize in Engineering lores. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Among the honour rolls for the Padma Shri award posted on January 26, Dr Lata Desai was hugged by** IIPH Gandhinagar( IIPH- G)on Thursday. **
 
• Najma Akhtar is the first woman vice-chancellor of **Jamia Millia Islamia(JMI), ** to receive the Padma Shri award.
